claims.quote: The Machine hums! Did you know that? Its hum penetrates our blood, and may even guide our thoughts.
claims.description: A hum from a central machine penetrates people's bodies and may guide their thoughts.

claims.quote: I had reached one of those pneumatic stoppers that defend us from the outer air.
claims.description: Sealed pneumatic stoppers guard underground dwellers from the outdoor air.

claims.quote: The surface of the earth supports life no longer.
claims.description: The surface of the earth has become unable to support higher forms of life.

claims.quote: The Machine feeds us and clothes us and houses us; through it we speak to one another, through it we see one another, in it we have our being.
claims.description: People come to worship a centralized machine that supplies all their needs and communication.

claims.quote: there will come a generation that has got beyond facts, beyond impressions, a generation absolutely colourless
claims.description: A future generation will be so detached from direct experience that it knows the world only through secondhand ideas.

claims.quote: The Machine is stopping, I know it, I know the signs.
claims.description: The central machine will stop functioning, a collapse one character believes he can foresee.
Human society will collapse into a state of being cast out onto the surface world.

claims.quote: A worm, a long white worm, had crawled out of the shaft and was gliding over the moonlit grass.
claims.description: Large white worms emerge from underground shafts to attack people on the surface.

claims.quote: So respirators were abolished, and with them, of course, the terrestrial motors
claims.description: People stop going to the surface, so respirators and surface vehicles are abolished.
